material.title: Companion outline
material.introduction: Meeting Journey is an independent companion. It keeps your place, prompts and notes here while the official reading and meeting material open in JW Library or on JW.org.

sections.heading: This week's focus
sections.body: Keep seeking Jehovah's help. The meeting workbook covers October 19–25 and Jeremiah 45–46.

sections.heading: Bible reading
sections.body: Jeremiah 46:13–24. Listen for the images, ideas or words you would like to remember.

sections.heading: Treasures from God's Word
sections.body: Baruch became discontent, but Jehovah helped him refocus by giving him hope. The spiritual gems question considers the sound of Egypt in Jeremiah 46:22.

sections.heading: Apply yourself to the ministry
sections.body: The demonstrations explore starting conversations with people who are happy, angry or sad, followed by a talk about Jesus.
sections.reference: Informal witnessing; house to house; lmd appendix A point 20

sections.heading: Living as Christians
sections.body: The discussion considers why Christians share, what we can share and how to learn generosity now.

parts.title: Hope Is Key to Contentment
parts.summary: Notice how Baruch became discontent, how discontent can affect joy and decisions, and how Jehovah helped him refocus with hope.

activities.prompt: Listen for the change from discontent to hope.

mission.title: Follow the hope trail
mission.listeningObjective: Notice what changes when Baruch is helped to look beyond his immediate situation.
clues: Listen for why Baruch was unhappy.
Notice what discontent can affect.
Look for the hopeful refocusing thought from Jeremiah 45:5.
